About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Database Specialist to join our team supporting telecommunications platforms and applications. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration, monitoring, performance optimisation, security, and availability of enterprise database environments while ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and operational standards.

Key Responsibilities

· Administer, maintain, and support enterprise database environments across production, development, testing, and disaster recovery platforms.

· Ensure database availability, performance, integrity, and security for mission-critical telecommunications applications.

· Perform proactive monitoring, performance tuning, capacity planning, and health checks.

· Manage database installations, upgrades, patching, migrations, and configuration changes.

· Support incident, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes.

· Investigate and resolve database-related incidents within agreed SLA and KPI targets.

· Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to minimize service disruptions.

· Manage database backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery processes.

· Support high availability and business continuity requirements for telecom services.

· Collaborate with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to ensure optimal platform performance.

· Develop and maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and technical runbooks.

· Participate in planned maintenance activities and on-call support rotations as required.

· Ensure compliance with security policies, governance standards, and operational procedures.

· Identify opportunities for automation and continuous service improvement.

Required Experience

· Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Database Administration or Database Support roles.

· Experience working within Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support environments.

· Proven experience supporting large-scale, high-availability database platforms.

· Experience managing production environments with strict SLA and KPI requirements.

· Experience supporting telecommunications, service provider, or mission-critical enterprise environments is highly desirable.

Technical SkillsDatabase Technologies

· Oracle Database

· Microsoft SQL Server

· MySQL

· PostgreSQL

Database Administration

· Database Installation and Configuration

· Performance Monitoring and Tuning

· Backup and Recovery

· Replication and High Availability

· Database Security and Access Management

· Capacity Planning

· Patch Management and Upgrades

Operational Support

· Incident Management

· Problem Management

· Change Management

· Root Cause Analysis

· Disaster Recovery Planning and Testing

· Service Monitoring and Reporting

Scripting & Automation

· SQL

· Shell/Bash Scripting

· PowerShell

· Python (desirable)

Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

· Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Microsoft SQL Server Certification, or equivalent database certifications.

· ITIL Foundation certification preferred.

· Experience supporting Telecom OSS/BSS platforms, Billing Systems, CRM platforms, Subscriber Management Systems, or Network Management Systems is highly desirable.

· Experience working within 24x7 operational support environments.

Key Attributes

· Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Managed Services environment.

· Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining operational stability and service quality.

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.

result.description:
UTS College provides a pathway for students into the University of Technology, Sydney (UTS), one of Australia's leading universities, and it is our vision to actualise potential and enhance lives through the power of learning, our actions and our people. Our purpose is to provide the best available opportunity for students to develop the knowledge, skills & attributes they need to attain their goals through market-leading courses, teaching excellence and an emphasis on the student experience.

About the Role
The Systems Engineer provides technical leadership and capability across project and business-as-usual activities. The role is responsible for designing, implementing, configuring, maintaining and optimising applications, network and server infrastructure that enable UTS College business operations.

The position contributes to the architecture, configuration, testing and deployment of applications and supporting infrastructure across both on premise and cloud-based environments. It plays a key role in resolving complex incidents, improving system reliability and performance, and delivering infrastructure enhancements aligned to business priorities.

Responsibilities
•	Undertakes or supervises complex installations and de-installations of systems or components, including handover
•	Schedules installation work around priorities and resource availability.
•	Monitors and manages incident queues to ensure incidents are handled according to procedures and service levels.
•	Contributes to developing, testing and improving incident management procedures. Uses analytics tools to track trends.
•	Applies technical expertise to maintain and optimise network infrastructure, executing updates and employing automation tools.
•	Uses network management tools to monitor load, performance, and security statistics. Investigates and enables the resolution of   network-related operational and security issues. 
•	Configures tools and/or creates scripts to automate network tasks.
•	Contributes to the planning and implementation of network maintenance, updates, and security enhancements. 
•	Implements agreed network changes and maintenance routines. 
•	Drives the adoption of tools and automated processes for effective operational management and delivery.
•	Oversees the planning, installation, maintenance and acceptance of new and updated infrastructure components and infrastructure-based services. Aligns to service expectations, security requirements and other quality standards.

About You
•	Experience in systems engineering, infrastructure or related technical roles.
•	Strong expertise in server administration, virtualization, cloud platforms (e.g. Azure/AWS), networking and security operations.
•	Relevant degree or industry recognized qualifications (or equivalent experience).
•	Solid understanding and practical application of ITIL service management practices.
•	Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing infrastructure solutions and automation.
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex technical issues.
•	Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What UTS College has to Offer[SA1.1]
•	A flexible work environment, including working from home and from our convenient inner-city campus within walking distance to Central Station.
•	Continuous learning and professional development (including ongoing learning & development opportunities, free LinkedIn Learning access and the UTS Library)
•	An easy-to-use Staff Recognition Program
•	Salary range – $75,000 - $95,000

If this sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you!
For more information about UTS College visit utscollege.edu.au

result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Data Business Analyst

Shape the future of data-driven healthcare at Epworth

At Epworth, Every Patient Matters. We are looking for a highly capable Data Business Analyst to join our team and play a key role in advancing our journey towards becoming a truly data-driven organisation. Working closely with business leaders, technical teams and reporting analysts, you'll transform business challenges into practical data solutions that improve decision-making and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Data and Decision Support, you will partner with stakeholders across the business to understand priorities, define requirements and design data solutions that support strategic objectives. You'll work at the intersection of business, technology and analytics, helping turn complex data into actionable insights that drive performance across Epworth

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Business Analyst who enjoys stakeholder engagement, solution design and project delivery in a collaborative healthcare environment.

You will:

Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business problems and gather requirements

Translate business needs into clear user stories, process maps, business rules and technical documentation

Work closely with Reporting Analysts and Data Governance teams to develop meaningful reporting, KPIs and dashboards

Support solution design, business case development and data-led decision making

Contribute to project delivery across Agile and Waterfall environments

Facilitate testing, user acceptance activities and stakeholder engagement

Deliver training, documentation and support to improve data literacy across the organisation

Position Description Inherent Requirement

About You

You will be a highly capable and motivated professional with strong interpersonal, organisational and stakeholder management skills, supported by excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Self-motivated and adaptable, you will thrive in fast-paced environments, demonstrate sound judgement and integrity, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and be committed to continuous improvement, quality outcomes and exceptional customer service.

To be successful, you will have:

Tertiary qualifications in Business, Data, Information Systems or a related discipline

Business Analysis qualifications or equivalent experience

3+ years experience in Business Analyst roles, with strong background in healthcare

Strong requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder engagement skills

Experience exploring and validating data using SSMS, BigQuery or similar cloud data platforms

Knowledge of healthcare operations, performance drivers and reporting environments

Experience working within Agile and project delivery frameworks

Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences

Experience with dashboard and reporting development will be highly regarded

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. If you're passionate about using data to drive better decisions and outcomes in healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

At Epworth, it's a community

It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation and a team that works to make sure that every patient matters. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

Relocation assistance is available for approved candidates

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. This includes First Nations peoples, people with disability, mature-age and young job seekers, members of the LGBTIQA+ community, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds. We are committed to providing an equitable, inclusive, and barrier-free recruitment experience for everyone.

If you need support during the application process or would like to discuss reasonable adjustments, we encourage you to let us know what you need to participate fully and confidently. We understand that sharing your needs can feel daunting, so please know that any information you provide will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and respect.

Apply now

As part of the application process, please also respond to the following selection criteria questions in your cover letter:

Key Selection Criteria Questions

What experience do you have working with healthcare data, hospital operations or healthcare performance reporting?

Have you used SQL, SSMS, BigQuery or similar tools to explore and validate data sources? Please provide an example.

What experience do you have working within Agile or project delivery environments?

Please advise your availability to commence employment and any notice period required.

Please outline your salary expectations (exclusive of superannuation).

For more information about the role, refer to the attached position description or contact talent@epworth.org.au or call (03) 9426 0606.

Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help us deliver smarter, data-driven healthcare solutions.

Apply now! Click I'm Interested and submit your CV and cover letter as a single document including brief responses to the selection criteria questions above.

Early applications are encouraged - shortlisting will commence immediately.

Apply now. we've over 8,000 perspectives at Epworth and we're ready to welcome yours!

It is a condition of employment with Epworth HealthCare, subject to reasonable exemptions, that you have had an annual Influenza vaccination, where this is required under Epworth policy.

As a child safe organisation, all successful applicants are required to satisfactorily clear a National Police Check (conducted by Epworth) and may be required to hold a valid employee Working with Children Check (provided by you).

At Epworth, we believe inclusion and diversity are essential to our culture and values.
